transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to get on the schedule in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Our available windows are Monday 0800-1200, Tuesday 0800-1600, and Wednesday 0800-1200. Before I sign the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on forklift-operator certification? Motor pool sergeant, where do we stand on the generator-operator refresher? And safety officer, what do we have on the hazmat refresher? Also let me know if there are any facility or safety constraints I need to be aware of for the training room, motor pool training bay, or safety classroom.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical constraint on the forklift-operator certification. The only currently certified forklift evaluator is available for the company session exactly Wednesday from 0900 to 1100. I confirmed the evaluator's duty roster this morning, but that roster change hasn't been added to the company training slide yet, so it wouldn't have been visible to anyone else. This means the forklift certification block must be scheduled Wednesday 0900-1100.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical constraint on the generator-operator refresher. The motor pool training bay is occupied by a scheduled generator load-bank inspection from Tuesday 0800 through 1200. I received the maintenance booking from the shop supervisor, but it hasn't been entered on the training calendar yet. This means the generator-operator refresher must be held Tuesday from 1300 to 1500.
